org.portico.bindings.jvm

Class Broadcaster

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.bindings.jvm.Broadcaster

  • public class Broadcaster
extends Object
    For each federation the JVM binding knows about, there exists a single Broadcaster. Any number of JVMConnections can register themselves with the broadcaster (assuming they each use a unique name). It is the Broadcasters responsibility to relay messages to each of the connections associated with the federation.

      • extendFOM

        public void extendFOM(List<ObjectModel> joinModules)
               throws JInconsistentFDD,
                      JRTIinternalError
        Extend the existing FOM with the given join modules. This call will first do a dry-run to ensure that the modules can be happily merged before it actually goes ahead and does the merge. If there is a problem detected during this dry run, an exception will be thrown.
        Throws:
        JInconsistentFDD
        JRTIinternalError
